items.heading_src: V. USE OF COMMON GROUNDS AND RECREATIONAL FACILITIES
paragraphs: V. USE OF COMMON GROUNDS AND RECREATIONAL FACILITIES

A. Use of the golf course is restricted to Members, lessees, or guests of either who pay greens fees. Annual golf memberships run from July 1 through June 30. Memberships are automatically terminated, without a refund, when a member is no longer a resident. A new Member is allowed to have a Golf Membership pro-rated for the first year only.
There are other multiple rules pertaining to the use of common grounds.  Be sure to go to that section of the Rules
